newsitem.title: USA: Kleinwort Benson keeps stance on Mexico, Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort Benson keeps stance on Mexico, Argentina.

text.p: Kleinwort Benson said on Friday it was maintaining its underweight stance on Mexico and neutral recommendation on Argentina with slight adjustments to its model Latin American stock portfolio.
Analysts Joe MacHatton and Rui Antunes said in a report the Mexican peso was still overvalued and Mexico's stock exchange was still too expensive.
They added that Argentina had "gotten slightly cheaper without justification."
The Mexican peso's drop and the corruption charges leveled by former Argentine Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo "are not significant or unforeseen events," the analysis said.
"... We are trimming our recommended weighting in Mexico from 19 percent to 18 percent ... and slightly increasing the recommended weighting in Argentina from 10 to 11 percent..."
They nominated Industrias Penoles SA de CV, Kimberly Clark de Mexico SA de CV and Grupo Tribasa as sells in Mexico.
The analysis recommended Compania Naviera Perez Companc, Astra Compania Argentina de Petroleo, Disco SA and Central Costanera SA as buys in Argentina.
